records.part: Design contract for a new Water SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system upgrade
records.reason: The firm determined to be best qualified for this project was the response submitted by Brock Solutions in the not to exceed amount of $1,335,349.

records.part: System Design Services deliverable for Water SCADA upgrade
Pre-Construction System Programming & Testing Services for Water SCADA upgrade
Control Panel Fabrication - fabricate and deliver control panels and backplates for the system upgrade

records.part: Construction Support Services including bid package development, submittal review, training, start-up and commissioning
Redevelop the HMI (human machine interface) to a new SCADA software platform
records.reason: Services provided in this contract will redevelop the HMI to a new system platform (VTScada).

records.part: Programmable Logic Centers (PLCs) and associated I/O devices changed to a new platform
records.reason: The PLCs and associated I/O (input and output) devices will be changed to a new platform.

records.part: Radio network upgrade for Water SCADA system
records.reason: Key elements of this contract include: (1) hardware modernization, (2) development of a new SCADA platform, (3) radio network upgrade, and (4) optimization of control and alarm strategies.

records.part: End-of-life Water SCADA system components requiring replacement
records.reason: Many components of the Water SCADA system are at end of life, or approaching end of life, which means they are no longer supported by or procurable from the manufacturer.

records.part: HMI graphics expansion to include new Water System assets such as Chick Lane Elevated Tower and Wells #20 and #21
records.reason: The HMI graphics will meet current industry standards and will be expanded to include new Water System assets (such as Chick Lane Elevated Tower and Wells #20 and #21) allowing system control from a single platform.
